title.zh: Morning Minute: OKX Raises at $25B From Circle, Ripple, and StanChart
title.en: Morning Minute: OKX Raises at $25B From Circle, Ripple, and StanChart

current_state.zh: OKX took new investment from Circle, Ripple, Standard Chartered's venture arm and Qube Research at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, extending Intercontinental Exchange's March investment at the same price.
current_state.en: OKX took new investment from Circle, Ripple, Standard Chartered's venture arm and Qube Research at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, extending Intercontinental Exchange's March investment at the same price.
